nodes.label: VSL Script-Writing Framework (5-stage playbook)
nodes.rationale: Every prompt, template, and checklist stored as files so a human, Claude Code, or a future autonomous agent runs the exact same process: 1 Product Intake -> 2 Avatar Research -> 3 Angle Generation -> 4 Script Writing -> 5 Shot List -> generation in vsls/<slug>/. Path to autonomy: manual now, then unattended stages 2-5 with human gates at avatar choice and final scripts, then fully autonomous with a media buyer feeding performance back.

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Copywriting Rules
nodes.rationale: Apply at every stage: FK reading level ~6.5, mass America, short punchy sentences; extreme specificity (real numbers, believable stories); one core idea per campaign; the avatar's own language, never invented jargon; emotional arc Fear -> Hope -> Belief -> Action; 'Say It Out Loud' test (if it sounds weird spoken by a 55-year-old man in Ohio, rewrite it).

nodes.label: products/<slug>/manifest.json State Tracking
nodes.rationale: Records which stage each campaign is at, the chosen avatar, existing angles/scripts, and performance.results[] - skills and agents read it to know where to resume; rewritten as full JSON, never mutated in place.
